verdict.rationale: Codegen supports some event-driven automation: agents can be triggered from CI/CD pipelines on build failures (codegen-docs-18) and automatically review PRs with defined checks (codegen-docs-20), plus programmatic triggering via SDK/API. However, there's no evidence of a general user-facing rules/automation engine where AI-native users define custom conditional triggers-and-actions across arbitrary events. Missing for 10: a documented rules/automation builder UI or config, support for arbitrary custom trigger conditions beyond CI/CD and PR events, and independent confirmation of reliability.
